result.analyst_notes: Mission-led, aspirational framing with absolute wording ('is to accelerate'). Mostly factual product history and specifications, written in third person about Tesla rather than first person. Environmental transition and product performance dominate. Customer affordability and grid benefits appear briefly. Employees, integrity and governance receive no attention.
